preconditions: Independent Primary4, safeguarding, trafficking-specialist, inclusion and rubric review before classroom use. Agree a local safeguarding response and an equivalent non-disclosure alternative.

Only a calm teacher-reviewed classroom message with a willing classmate; no public route, outside audience/contact, real case, names/photos/addresses, personal disclosures, graphic content, fear imagery, or victim/trafficker role-play.

Do not make pupils investigate, identify suspects, rescue anyone, make a report to an agency or promise secrecy. Any spontaneous concern is handled privately by responsible adults under the school safeguarding process, not treated as assessment evidence.

evidenceRequirements: Observe the pupil’s own plan, original material and actual heard delivery against each criterion. A written plan or group attendance alone is not performance. Record only minimal non-sensitive assessment evidence.
